contexts.text: The farina of fine flour () = the Spiritual and the Celestial then with the Lord. AC 2177:7. AC 2183.

The meal which Elisha cast into the pot () = the truth which is from good, or the Spiritual which is from the Celestial. Thus it signified that the mass was amended by means of spiritual truth from the Word. AC 8408:end. AC 10105:3. AR 411:end. AE 618:6.

To take the millstone and grind meal () = to hatch doctrinal things from truths which they pervert; for meal, being from wheat or barley, = truths from good; but in the opposite sense, the truths which they pervert in order to seduce.
The barrel of meal () = truth from good. ( = the good of truth. AC 9198:7.)
Corn is ground into flour, and is thus prepared for bread, and by flour is signified the truth from which is good, and by bread the good itself therefrom.
Meal () = the truth from which is good.
Flour and fine flour = truth; the dough, the good of truth; and the bread, the good of love.
The bud shall yield no meal () = barrenness, because there is no truth from good.
The meal () = the truth of the Church; and the oil, its good.

To grind meal () = to pick out such things from the sense of the letter of the Word as serve to confirm the evils of the loves of self and of the world... To grind = to pick out... and meal = the truth serving for that. ( = truth falsified. AC 10303:end.)
Wheat and barley = celestial and spiritual good, and therefore fine flour and meal = truth from that good...
Besides many other things of a like sort.
Faith from truths is like the seed of the produce of the fields, which on being ground yields meal.
